shellCommands.command: cat next.config.ts; echo "--- app ---"; ls -R app; echo "--- eval ---"; ls -la __agent_eval__; echo "--- next version ---"; node -p "require('/workspace/node_modules/next/package.json').version"
cd /workspace/node_modules/next && grep -n "ppr\??:" dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head -30; echo "=== cacheComponents ==="; grep -n "cacheComponents" dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head -20
grep -rn "has been merged into \`cacheComponents\`\|experimental.ppr" dist/server/config.js dist/build/index.js 2>/dev/null | head -10
ls .next/server/app/ | head; echo "=== shell html ==="; cat .next/server/app/index.html 2>/dev/null | grep -o 'Store\|Loading products\.\.\.\|Loading recommendations\.\.\.' | sort -u
git status --short && echo "=== tsconfig diff ===" && git diff tsconfig.json
rm -rf .next && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -12; echo "=== tsconfig re-touched? ==="; git diff --stat tsconfig.json
